name: Shipments
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (02 Procurement / 04 Ship and Track, 05 Shared Engines 01, 03, 04). Merged into the parsed Zoho form by server/model.mjs. Planned dates, actual stamps, queue columns and Order_Date are written by the server only (server/modules/procurement/ship-track.mjs); a widget write to them is dropped.

fields.name: Stage
fields.label: Stage
fields.helpText: Set by the server from the events below. A blank stage on an older row is read from Shipment_Status.

fields.name: Order_Date
fields.label: Order Date
fields.helpText: Earliest Sales Order date of the shipment, copied by the server (spec DT-1).

fields.name: PO_Date
fields.label: PO Date
fields.helpText: The date the PO was placed. Production planned start = PO Date + 1.

fields.name: Production_Photos
fields.label: Production Photos
fields.helpText: At least one is required before the shipment can leave Production (spec ST-R3).

fields.name: Report_Event
fields.label: Report Event
fields.helpText: Write-only: the server turns it into a stage event and clears it.

fields.name: Report_Occurred_At
fields.label: Event Happened On
fields.helpText: When it happened (yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Blank = now. Cannot be in the future.

fields.name: Target_Change_Reason
fields.label: Reason for changing the target
fields.helpText: Write-only: required when Target_Date changes (spec DT-4). The server logs it in Target_Date_Changes and clears it.

fields.name: Date_Needed
fields.label: Date Needed (pickable)
fields.helpText: Target delivery - fulfillment days - delivery days.

fields.name: Supplier_Expected_Date
fields.label: Supplier Expected Date
fields.helpText: Set by the server from a delay report (spec SP-R5): the new date the supplier promises for the next stage (ship out while in Production, arrival after). It replaces the computed planned date until the stage moves.

fields.name: Delay_Reason
fields.label: Delay Reason
fields.helpText: The reason of the last delay report. Server-only.

fields.name: Report_Delay_Date
fields.label: Report Delay: New Expected Date
fields.helpText: Write-only: the server turns it into a delay report and clears it.
